DAAD Scholarship for Developing Countries 2026

Published by the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD).

Overview

The DAAD Scholarship for Developing Countries funds postgraduate study in Germany for applicants from eligible developing nations.

Application Deadline

31 October 2026

Eligible Countries

  • Nigeria
  • Kenya
  • Ghana
  • Ethiopia
  • South Africa

Funding

Monthly stipend of €934, plus tuition coverage, travel allowance, and health insurance for the duration of the programme.

Application URL

Apply online
